headline: Cornell reaches 50 goals in road win at Rutgers
dek: A road victory at Rutgers carried Cornell to fifteen wins across all matches, against just one draw and three losses, while allowing nineteen goals. With every other conference program finished for the season, Cornell alone plays on and welcomes Grand Canyon next.
displaced_by: Cornell beat Rutgers for a fifteenth win and 50th goal, making the previous dek's fourteen-win figure stale.
